newsitem.title: USA: Foilmark board to weigh unsolicited bid.
newsitem.headline: Foilmark board to weigh unsolicited bid.

text.p: Foilmark Inc said Wednesday its board will meet today to discuss an unsolicited takeover bid by Advanced Deposition Technologies Inc.
Foilmark, in a statement, confirmed the offer, which it said was for cash and stock. However, it did not specify the amount of the bid and the proportion of cash and stock.
It said the board, at its meeting, will also seek to obtain additional information so it can adequately evaluate the merits of the proposal.
Foilmark makes hot foil, holographic films and related hot stamping equipment.
Advanced Deposition, based in Taunton, Mass., commercializes new technologies and products related to thin films, coatings, dielectric film and vapor depositions.
